title: Cross-capability World Query DAG acceptance
statusReason: All controlled in-process Provider Runtime chains pass, but the same chains were not executed against the real external CRS, Geometry, H3 Toolkit, and PostgreSQL services.

acceptance.evidence: The actual CRS and Spatial Provider Runtimes execute a projected EPSG:3857 point through typed DAG bindings. The normalized [116.4,39.9] coordinate reaches parameterized ST_DWithin under DataScope default; the Spatial result has CONSISTENT_AT_START Data Snapshot and current-projection Evidence.

The actual CRS, Geometry, and Spatial Provider Runtimes execute Normalize to immutable Validate to parameterized ST_Covers. Validation returns valid=true and repairApplied=false before the exact query.
A self-intersecting polygon returns valid=false. VALUE_EQUALS fails, the Spatial node is SKIPPED with attempt=0, the World Query is PARTIAL, and zero Spatial operation SQL calls occur.

The invalid polygon proceeds only through the explicit geometry.make-valid node. The CRS node's typed /geometry output binds directly to /input/geometry; explicit canonical literals bind /input/coordinateSpace and /input/coordinateLayout. No repair operand is accepted from request parameters. The Receipt records repairApplied=true and Polygon to MultiPolygon type change; a second immutable validation passes and the exact Spatial query executes.

H3 cover returns candidateOnly=true and exactVerificationRequired=true with no Data Snapshot or World Evidence. The scoped Situation provider resolves two ReferenceKeys from controlled world-data mappings; Spatial receives both through a parameterized JSONB prefilter and ST_Intersects returns one exact object with CONSISTENT_AT_START Data Snapshot and Evidence.

Two tracklet sequences separated by an UNKNOWN gap reach the H3 analysis bridge as two distinct trajectory arrays. The output declares gapPolicy=SEQUENCE_ISOLATED and creates no World Data Snapshot or Evidence.
